Frame-count convention BROKEN by real packs: sayaka idle has SEVEN painted cells (canonical 6); openpets validator sample waving=5 failed=6. Hardcoded counts WILL render blank/flicker on some live packs. Mitigation: alpha-scan rows at load, clamp anim to min(hardcoded,scanned), log drift
